top_gaps: ODES vs Replay boundary fails at the exact lock tuple on lost-ack and prior-absence exports; test_explicit_export_end_to_end matches no mandatory selector (regex-selected matrix) and the verdict stayed PASS.
Mandatory evidence is name/regex-selected (rows like 'min N tests matching revok|expir'), not contract-mapped; Hub qualification-surfaces-v1.json has 2 structural contracts only.

No evidence at the tuple actually in use: GAX main e78a7be3 has component-local tests only; newer security evidence (R1B/R1C/S3 wiki) is at the current-stack tuple (CP b19c47dd) and is non-transferable; the lock's qualification_evidence (run 37694032916) predates the p2 pins; migrated registry untested and unlocked.
Authentication/identity is thinly negative-covered (id-string adapter identity, asserted signer names, HMAC-only, sender label unbound).

Duplicate-effect prevention is effect-id only on default routes; same-intent duplicates are a documented residual; operation-identity/dedupe/refund-intent/terminal-revocation are opt-in and off by default.
Temporal/status limits are asserted rather than enforced (decision age, claim consumption vs identity/mandate status, C0 race, freshness ordering xfail).
Adversarial batch T01-T20 and verifier mutation have no run at the lock tuple and feed no gate (stale; ran at r10 tuple).
Restore/durability limits at exact tuple: no external anchor (D07), no OS-level kill routes A/C (C08), no ingress limiter (D06).
Required GitHub checks do not include the p2 native suite; cross-component / reference is red on Hub main and on #263 head; the four qualify-linux batches are named file lists.
Matrix identity: at the lock tuple (g8) the 40 Qualification SCN-* rows are 0 PASS, 27 INCONCLUSIVE, 13 NOT RUN; that is a different artifact from the Hub 35-scenario acceptance matrix.
baseline.contract_manifest_status: Existing structures reused, no second registry: lock interfaces strings, Qualification contract-matrix.json (cognous.contract-matrix/1: 1 contract, 2 boundaries), Hub qualification-surfaces-v1.json (2 optional structural contracts). ODES draft contracts (17, all 0.1.0-draft, not frozen) exist; ODES-INTERCOMPONENT-CONTRACTS.md is rev 0.2 draft and says none of it applies until V1 closes. Whether they form the S2 baseline is AD-05.
